sloka: अनया चित्रया वाचा त्रिस्थान व्यंजनस्थयाः ।कस्य न आराध्यते चित्तम् उद्यत् असे अरेः अपि ॥४-३-३३॥
transliteration: anayā citrayā vācā tristhāna vyaṁjanasthayāḥ ।kasya na ārādhyate cittam udyat ase areḥ api ॥4-3-33॥

translations.english: 'His colourful words flow from all the three sources: the bottom of his bosom, his throat and his head. Whose mind will not adore them even if one happens to be an enemy holding a sword?
